release_notes:
SMS notifications: opt-out model with per-client control

- Order-notification SMS is now opt-out. With a workflow enabled in Settings > SMS, every client with a valid phone number receives the notification unless they have opted out. The old per-customer and per-service Send SMS requirements are gone.
- Clients can turn SMS off themselves from My Profile (Receive SMS Notifications), which overrides the global setting for that client.
- Removed the admin per-user Send SMS checkbox from the client edit page (clients now manage their own preference).
